recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the core specification. If the Android FHIR SDK still needs to be listed, update the relevant Confluence registry page outside this FHIR core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-33980 asked to add the Android FHIR SDK as an example open source library for implementers. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution said reference implementation information would move to a Confluence page referenced from the downloads page, with the Android SDK information added there.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-33980 was found. Related R5 commits f575ef6b27e6bc5fc01db942c9cf8d00f50099f2, 472abf78c495c2ae44924d499be7434ed50788d0, and e404ccd07129409bf907b904ae62ded6c82d28bf applied the same change family by moving reference implementation and implementation tool lists from core source pages to Confluence links.
additional_context: The current source/implsupport-module.html Reference Implementations (Libraries) section links to Confluence Open Source Implementations, source/downloads.html points implementation tools to the FHIR Tools Registry, and source/hierarchy.xml plus publish.ini show those pages are active build inputs. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later source decision requiring an Android SDK row to be restored in core.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source was edited because adding the Android FHIR SDK directly to source/implsupport-module.html or source/downloads.html would conflict with the modified resolution and with the current Confluence-maintained registry model.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue that moved downloads-page reference implementations to a Confluence list instead of enumerating libraries in core.
Published/Persuasive with Modification issue and application commits that split implementation tools and reference implementations out of spec pages and into Confluence-backed registries.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to add Android FHIR SDK as an open source library example, resolved by moving reference implementation information to a Confluence page referenced from downloads.
evidence_items.learned: The final work-group decision was to maintain mutable reference implementation information on Confluence rather than add an Android-specific row to core source.

evidence_items.summary: Implementation Support points developers to the Confluence Open Source Implementations page, and Downloads points implementation tools to the Confluence FHIR Tools Registry.
evidence_items.learned: The current source already uses the Confluence handoff requested by the modified resolution and related cleanup.
